title: HDL-Based 4-Floor Lift Controller
summary: FPGA-based elevator controller designed using Hardware Description Language (HDL) and Finite State Machine (FSM) architecture.
problem: Multi-floor elevator dispatch logic requires deterministic real-time control, priority scheduling, and fail-safe safety interlocks.
solution: Implemented a robust Finite State Machine in Verilog/VHDL synthesized for FPGA execution with simulated push-button request queues.
features: Comprehensive FSM implementation managing Idle, Moving Up, Moving Down, and Door Open states
Priority request queuing for floor calls with directional optimization
Simulation testbench verification validating edge cases and emergency signal responses
